description: This file defines a template class TlsEnabled for managing TLS configuration in WebSocket connections, including setting certificates, keys, CA files, and establishing secure contexts.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing TLS setup and management for WebSocket connections, including certificate handling and context initialization.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the TLS certificate.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the private key.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate files.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes TLS handling by setting the TLS init handler.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Determines if TLS connection is authenticated based on connection error codes.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Creates and configures the SSL context for TLS connections.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context.
